scope: salience evaluation configuration frozen before OC-02 implementation and before any test-label inspection; policy-only, no status fields

evaluation.family_split: temporal parent-family split with no parent or descendant of a test family in train

metrics.shortlist_recall: recorded separately from causal-verifier recall so a missed nomination is never mislabeled a causal-verifier failure

selection_pipeline.candidate_generation: bounded lexical candidates plus bounded positive-prior candidates, generated independently
selection_pipeline.overflow_policy: checked arithmetic; widen to u128; fail closed on any overflow or out-of-range final value

non_claims: no causal C2 claim without causal/human/B8 evidence
preregistration does not approve, define, or claim OC-02 implementation
preregistration freezes evaluation policy only; it does not claim any evaluation result
